cell.label: Epiglottitis suspected; urgent anesthesia, ENT, surgery consults, with direct visualization to confirm diagnosis and degree of airway obstruction
Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics to cover gram-positive bacteria and H. influenza with culture and laboratories
Monitor in critical care for 8-12 h with frequent vital signs and pulse oximetry and repeated questioning regarding respiratory symptoms; if worsening or dyspnea, intubate
Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics to cover gram-positive bacteria and H. influenza (if not already done) with culture and labs

footnotes.footnote: Adapted from Hebert PC, Ducic Y, Boisvert D, Lamothe A. Adult epiglottitis in a Canadian setting. Laryngoscope 1998;108:64-69.
